title: 50/30/20 rule
tip: Split take-home income roughly 50% needs, 30% wants, 20% savings or debt repayment. On 12,000 THB that is about 6,000 / 3,600 / 2,400.
source: Elizabeth Warren & Amelia Warren Tyagi, All Your Worth (2005)

title: Build an emergency fund
tip: Keep 3-6 months of essential expenses in an easy-access savings account; start with a small first target such as one month.

title: Audit subscriptions
tip: List every recurring charge, cancel ones you don't use, and look for duplicate accounts or plans billed twice.

title: Pay yourself first
tip: Move a fixed amount to savings on the day money arrives, before spending; spend only what is left (ออมก่อนใช้).
source: Bank of Thailand financial literacy materials

title: Track every expense
tip: Record income and spending daily (a simple income-expense journal or app) and review totals by category each week.
source: Bank of Thailand financial literacy materials

title: Weekly spending allowance (envelope method)
tip: Divide monthly flexible spending into weekly allowances so you can't use next week's money early; when a week's envelope is empty, stop.
source: Dave Ramsey, The Total Money Makeover (envelope system)

title: Sinking fund for irregular costs
tip: Set aside a small amount every month for predictable but irregular costs (repairs, devices, fees) so they don't wreck one month's budget.

title: Pay credit cards in full
tip: Pay the full statement balance each month; paying only the minimum lets interest build up quickly.
